model: Personal Activity Vehicle PAV3-3CB Lightning Electric
description:
It's ELECTRIC!! An Easy Chair On Wheels, sturdy, comfortable and cool. Rear 24x2.125 wheels, THREE SPEED coaster brake and front drum brake

If you seek the most comfortable, cool, durable E Trike in the world, the Worksman Lightning PAV is the cycle for you. Pedal, Power, or both, this attractive cycle sets the standard for comfort, style and durability Electric Drive version Personal Activity Vehicle with 3 speed coaster (foot) brake, and front drum brake. The Ultimate Comfort Trike built "Worksman Tough". Freedom, mobility and fun will be all yours on this amazing, high quality E-Trike. PAV3 (tm) Trikes shown with optional armrests, fenders and mirrors. PAV Factoids: Height from ground of seat 24.25". Key seat Dimensions 18.5" Wide 13.5" High Weight Capacity 550 Pounds Worksman Cycles has partnered with two overseas suppliers to create the ultimate electric front hub drive system. The Worksman Lightning E Kit. Featuring a comprehensive color LED dashboard, 48V Lithium Ion Battery with integrated LED Taillight, easy to use throttle and reverse function and powerful drive system. Includes easy to use charger. Note: We find that for riders taller than 5'9", or if your inseam is over 31", or if weight exceeds 350 pounds the Stretched Model is recommended for greater comfort and seat adjust-ability. Riders over 6'0" must choose the Stretch Model from the right side bar or the previous page. All Pav trikes ship 99% assembled via Truck
